title.en: A new logo
title.zh: 全新 logo

en: LetsMeetVerse has a new logo: puffy pink, sky-blue and butter-yellow letters with a little heart speech bubble on top.

You’ll find it on the sign-in screen, in the character creator, on this website and its banner, and on the app icons for your phone’s home screen and the Windows app (the small icons carry just the heart bubble, so it stays clear).
zh: LetsMeetVerse 换上了全新的 logo：圆滚滚的粉色、天蓝和奶油黄字母，头顶还有一个装着爱心的对话框。
登录页、创建角色页、这个网站和首页横幅，还有手机桌面图标和 Windows 版的程式图标都换成了新 logo（小图标只用爱心对话框，缩小了也看得清）。

alt.en: The sign-in screen with the new LetsMeetVerse logo above chibi friends on a star-paved LA sidewalk
alt.zh: 登录页上的新 LetsMeetVerse logo，下面是一群Q版朋友走在铺着星星的洛杉矶人行道上

title.en: Pre-registration is open
title.zh: 开放预约

en: You can now pre-register right here on the website: leave your email, and you’ll be the first to know when more of LA opens its doors. We only email you about LetsMeetVerse, and you can unsubscribe any time.
Signing up with your Google account, on the site and in the game, is coming next.
zh: 现在可以直接在网站上预约了：留下邮箱，洛杉矶开放更多名额时你会第一个知道。我们只发 LetsMeetVerse 相关的邮件，随时可以退订。
用 Google 账号预约、在游戏里用 Google 登录，也马上就来。

title.en: Fixing the map: Ocean Avenue, the pier and the car lots
title.zh: 修地图：Ocean Ave、码头和停车场

en: Ocean Avenue sat on a 6-metre plateau, with steep paved slopes and little cliffs all around its edges. Now only the bluff-top park is raised, climbing up from the sand; the street, the café, Coastline Studios and the blocks behind them are back on level ground.
The pier’s deck and the carousel’s platform now meet, so there’s no strip of sea between them any more. Buildings also stop turning see-through when you stand at their door.

Gas stations, car washes, drive-thrus and public car parks used to sit in the far corner of a huge empty lot. They now stand right on their street, and the spare asphalt behind them has become a little green with shade trees.
zh: Ocean Ave 以前整条街被抬高成 6 米的高台，四边都是很陡的铺砖斜坡和小断崖。现在只有海边的崖顶公园是高的，从沙滩一路坡上去；马路、咖啡店、Coastline Studios 和后面的街区都回到了平地。
码头甲板和旋转木马平台接上了，中间不再隔着一条海水。站在楼门口时，整栋楼也不会再变成半透明了。
加油站、洗车场、得来速和公共停车场以前缩在一大片空停车场的角落，现在都挪到了马路边，后面空出来的柏油地变成了种着树的小草地。

alt.en: The Seabreeze Carousel on one continuous pier deck, string lights along the rails
alt.zh: 海风旋转木马馆和连成一整块的码头甲板，栏杆上挂着串灯

alt.en: A gas station by the street with a lawn and rows of young trees behind it
alt.zh: 马路边的加油站，后面是一片草地和一排排小树

alt.en: A public car park beside the Walk of Stars, with palms and trees where empty asphalt used to be
alt.zh: 星光大道旁的公共停车场，原来空着的柏油地种上了棕榈和小树

title.en: Hop, and Sichuan mahjong at Four Corners
title.zh: 可以跳了，四角麻将馆加入四川麻将

en: Press Space or the jump button to hop. Everyone nearby sees it, so you can wave hello with a little bounce.

Four Corners Mahjong Club now has Sichuan tables (blood battle to the end): 108 tiles, swap three tiles, pick a suit to give up, and play keeps going after the first player wins until three have won or the wall runs out. Hong Kong style tables are still there.
zh: 按空格键或跳跃按钮就能跳一下，附近的人都看得到，打招呼的时候可以蹦一蹦。
四角麻将馆新开了四川麻将桌（血战到底）：108 张牌、换三张、定缺，有人胡了还会接着打，直到三家胡牌或者牌摸完。港式麻将桌也都还在。

title.en: Livelier driving, rain you can see, and Santa Monica’s new look
title.zh: 开车更有感觉、看得见的雨，还有圣莫尼卡新面貌

en: Cars now steer with turning wheels and a bit of suspension bounce. Press E to get in or out, and invite friends to ride along.
Rain falls in soft streaks with little splash rings on the pavement, puddles reflect the sky, and everyone carries an umbrella, with new recorded sounds for rain and cars.
Santa Monica got new hand-made 3D buildings and street pieces, everything across LA now shares one consistent scale, and the City Map has a pin for every place plus a list by category.
zh: 开车时轮子会跟着转向，车身还会轻轻颠一下。按 E 上车下车，也可以邀请朋友一起坐。
下雨时能看到细细的雨丝，路面会溅起小水花，水坑会映出天空，大家都撑起了雨伞；雨声和车声也都换成了新的实录音效。
圣莫尼卡换上了新的 3D 建筑和街道小物件，全洛杉矶的比例统一了，城市地图上每个地点都有图钉，还能按分类列出来。

title.en: Palm Fortune slots and a real roulette wheel
title.zh: Palm Fortune 老虎机和真正的轮盘

en: The slot machines and the roulette table at Lucky Palms are real games now. Palm Fortune has three reels, bet sizes and a paytable you can open any time.

Roulette is the European single-zero wheel. Up to six players share a table and bet on numbers, red or black, odd or even, high or low, dozens and columns. Everything is played with in-game coins only, and the gaming floor is for players 18 and over.
zh: Lucky Palms 的老虎机和轮盘桌现在都能真的玩了。Palm Fortune 有三个转轮，可以选押注大小，赔率表随时能打开看。
轮盘是欧式单零轮盘，每桌最多 6 个人一起玩，可以押数字、红黑、单双、大小、打和列。全部只用游戏币，赌场只对 18 岁以上的玩家开放。

alt.en: Palm Fortune slot machine after a win: three reels showing a bell, a gold bar and a seven
alt.zh: Palm Fortune 老虎机中奖的画面：三个转轮停在铃铛、金条和 7 上

alt.en: The roulette table at Lucky Palms with the wheel on the left and the betting layout on the right
alt.zh: Lucky Palms 的轮盘桌：左边是转盘，右边是下注区

title.en: Autopilot: your character lives on for two hours a day
title.zh: 挂机：每天 2 小时，角色自己过日子

en: Busy? Switch on Autopilot from the phone and your character carries on without you: they go to their shift, eat, rest, wash and hang out, even after you close the game.
Everyone gets two real hours a day. Autopilot work pays the base wage only, it never gambles or buys anything big, and when you come back a "While you were away" card tells you what happened.
zh: 没空玩的时候，在手机里打开「挂机」，角色会自己过日子：去上班、吃饭、休息、洗漱、找人聊天，关掉游戏也会继续。
每人每天有现实时间 2 小时。挂机上班只拿底薪，不会去赌博，也不会买大件东西。回来的时候会有一张「你不在时」的卡片，告诉你这段时间发生了什么。

alt.en: A character with an AUTO tag walking to work in Koreatown while the Autopilot card shows the time left today
alt.zh: 带着 AUTO 标签的角色正走去韩国城上班，挂机卡片显示今天还剩多少时间

alt.en: The While you were away card: time used, shifts worked, wallet change and the needs bars
alt.zh: 「你不在时」卡片：用了多少时间、上了几个班、钱包变化和各项状态

title.en: Sleeping under the duvet
title.zh: 盖着被子睡觉

en: Beds used to swallow everyone but their heads. Now you can see the shape of the body under the duvet, the cover folds back at the chest, and shoulders and hands stay on top.
Getting in and out of bed has its own little motion, and it works the same in single beds, double beds, hotel rooms and the studio.
zh: 以前躺上床只剩一颗头露在外面。现在被子底下看得出身体轮廓，被角折在胸口，肩膀和双手露在上面。
上床、下床也有自己的小动作，单人床、双人床、酒店和小公寓都一样。

alt.en: Two friends asleep in a double bed under a pink duvet in a sunny studio
alt.zh: 两个朋友在阳光小公寓的双人床上盖着粉色被子睡觉

title.en: What you buy is what you wear
title.zh: 买到的就是穿上的

en: Shop pictures and the clothes on your character now come from the same 3D model, so the cream sunglasses in the shop are the cream sunglasses on your face.
Every item was checked on every body type, hairstyle and pose: nothing floats, clips through or shows skin where it shouldn't, and a render check catches it if it ever does.
zh: 商店里的图片和穿在角色身上的衣服，现在用的是同一个 3D 模型。商店里看到奶油色框的墨镜，戴上就是那副墨镜。
每件衣服都在每种体型、发型和动作下检查过：不会浮起来、不会穿模，也不会露出不该露的地方。以后如果出问题，自动渲染检查会拦下来。

alt.en: The Fashion District Outlet shop with the cream sunglasses selected
alt.zh: Fashion District Outlet 服饰店，选中了奶油色框的墨镜

title.en: A new City Map
title.zh: 全新的城市地图

en: Press M and the City Map is now a clean illustrated map: districts in soft colours, the main streets, pins for homes, food, shops and work, and your friends.

Drag to explore, scroll to zoom and search for a place by name. The weather icon in the top-left corner now has every kind of weather by day and night, and the food trucks were rebuilt as little toy kitchens.
zh: 按 M 打开的城市地图换成了清爽的插画地图：街区用柔和的颜色区分，画出主要街道，还标出了家、吃的、商店、上班地点和朋友的位置。
可以拖动、滚轮缩放，也可以直接搜索地名。左上角的天气图标补齐了白天和夜晚的各种天气，餐车也重新做成了小玩具厨房。

alt.en: The illustrated City Map with Hollywood, Koreatown, Downtown LA, Santa Monica and Venice
alt.zh: 插画风的城市地图，标着好莱坞、韩国城、市中心、圣莫尼卡和威尼斯

title.en: Lucky Palms, an Art Deco casino
title.zh: Lucky Palms：装饰艺术风的赌场

en: Mid-City has a casino now. The building glows at night: an ivory front, a teal tower, a gold CASINO sign and a marquee full of warm bulbs.

Inside there are slot machines, a roulette table, a cashier booth and a teal lounge. The blackjack tables are the real thing: up to three players per table, and resident players fill the empty seats so a game can always start.
zh: 中城开了一家赌场。夜里整栋楼都会亮：象牙白的外墙、孔雀绿的塔楼、金色的 CASINO 招牌，还有一圈暖光灯泡的雨棚。
里面有老虎机、轮盘桌、筹码兑换柜台和孔雀绿的休息区。21 点是真的能玩的：每桌最多 3 个玩家，人不够时会有居民坐上来补位，随时都能开局。

alt.en: The casino at night: a gold CASINO sign above a glowing entrance, the hills and the observatory lit up behind it
alt.zh: 夜里的赌场：发光的入口上方是金色 CASINO 招牌，后面是亮着灯的山和天文台

alt.en: Inside the casino: residents playing at half-moon green blackjack tables, slot machines along the wall
alt.zh: 赌场里面：居民在半月形绿色 21 点桌旁打牌，墙边一排老虎机

title.en: Jobs you actually play
title.zh: 上班不再挂机

en: Work is a little game now. Couriers pick up several orders at once, each with a real door and a countdown: on time earns a bonus and a tip, late costs that order's bonus, and a perfect run pays extra.

Supermarket staff scan baskets and restock shelves with a shared queue of shoppers, and the café's baristas play quick connect-two rounds that get harder and pay more. A rough shift still pays the base wage.
zh: 上班变成了小游戏。外卖骑手一次接好几单，每单都有真实的送达门口和倒计时：准时有奖金和小费，迟到扣那一单的奖金，全部准时还有额外奖励。
超市店员要给排队的顾客扫码结账、给货架补货；咖啡店店员玩连连看，关卡越往后越难，奖励也越高。就算发挥不好，底薪照样拿。

alt.en: A supermarket shift: the checkout panel shows a customer's three items to scan, with shelves and shoppers behind
alt.zh: 超市上班：结账面板上是顾客要扫的三件商品，后面是货架和顾客

title.en: Paint, sell, and play Draw & Guess
title.zh: 画画、卖画，还有你画我猜

en: Set up an easel in a park or the museum and paint on a real little canvas. Hang your work at home or put it up in the Art Market with a fixed price or an auction.
The city calendar now lists group events, starting with Draw & Guess: teams of two take turns drawing and guessing, and the winning pair takes home 500 coins.
zh: 在公园或博物馆支起画架，在真的小画布上画画。画好的作品可以挂在家里，也可以拿去艺术集市，自己定价或者拍卖。
城市日历上有了团体活动，第一个是你画我猜：两人一队，轮流画和猜，赢的一队拿走 500 金币。

alt.en: The painting studio: brushes and a colour palette on the left, a calm sunset over the sea on the canvas
alt.zh: 画画工作室：左边是画笔和调色盘，画布上是海上的落日

alt.en: A Draw & Guess round: a simple house drawn on the board, a guess box and a one-minute timer
alt.zh: 你画我猜：画板上画了一座小房子，旁边是猜词框和一分钟倒计时

title.en: Coin runs on the boardwalk
title.zh: 海边步道上的金币跑酷

en: Jogging can be a game now. Pick a goal of 20 to 100 coins, then run down the boardwalk, a park path or a city street: switch lanes, jump the benches and grab the coins.
Hit your goal and the jog's reward gets a 10% bonus. Collect half and you get half.
zh: 慢跑可以变成小游戏了。先选一个目标，20 到 100 枚金币，然后在海边步道、公园小路或城市街道上跑：换道、跳过长椅、吃金币。
达到目标，慢跑奖励额外加 10%；只吃到一半，就拿一半。

alt.en: A coin run on the beach boardwalk between rows of palm trees, the coin counter at 10 of 40
alt.zh: 在两排棕榈树之间的海边步道上跑酷，金币计数 10 / 40

title.en: Parking, Palm Motors and cozier nights
title.zh: 停车场、Palm Motors，还有更舒服的夜晚

en: Hollywood has public parking and Palm Motors, a car dealership where you can browse, pick a paint colour and take a test drive.

Double beds really fit two now, and you sleep under the duvet. We also closed the gaps in every hairstyle, put a carousel hall on the pier, and the Status page now tells you where to go to raise each need or skill.
zh: 好莱坞有了公共停车场和 Palm Motors 车行：可以看车、挑车漆颜色，还能试驾。
双人床现在真的能睡两个人，而且是盖着被子睡。我们还修好了所有发型露头皮的地方，码头上多了一座旋转木马馆；状态页也会告诉你，想提升哪项需求或技能该去哪里。

alt.en: Palm Motors in Hollywood: a glass showroom on a sunny street corner with palm trees and a parking sign
alt.zh: 好莱坞的 Palm Motors：阳光街角的玻璃展厅，周围是棕榈树和停车标志

title.en: LA became a planet
title.zh: 洛杉矶变成了一颗星球

en: The city no longer ends at an edge. Los Angeles now wraps around a small planet, the streets have three times the room, and there's open land waiting for new neighborhoods.

A day also moves faster: a full 24 hours now takes 15 real minutes. Friends who share their location show up on the City Map, so you can tap one and walk over. Bus stops are fewer now, and you can board at every one.
zh: 城市不再有尽头。洛杉矶现在绕着一颗小星球连成一圈，街道之间的空间是原来的三倍，还留了空地给以后的新街区。
时间也过得更快了：现实 15 分钟就是游戏里一整天。开了位置分享的好友会出现在城市地图上，点一下就能走过去找 TA。公交站少了，但每一站都能上车。

alt.en: The City Map on a phone: pink pins for two friends, one selected with a Go to them button
alt.zh: 手机上的城市地图：两个好友的粉色头像针，选中其中一个后出现“去找 TA”按钮

title.en: Every window got the Home Shop look
title.zh: 所有弹窗都换上了 Home Shop 的新衣服

en: Shops, your bag, the phone apps, Settings, the map and the Together menus now share one look: the soft pink Home Shop style, with rounded shelves, chunky coin prices and big friendly buttons.
It works on phones too. Headers keep your coins and the close button on screen, and everything is easier to tap.
zh: 商店、背包、手机 App、设置、地图，还有“一起玩”的各种菜单，现在都是同一种风格：柔和的粉色 Home Shop 样式，圆圆的货架、大大的金币价格和好按的按钮。
手机上也一样好用：标题栏始终显示金币和关闭按钮，所有按钮都更容易点到。

alt.en: The Home Shop window: furniture categories on the left, a pink sofa picked on the right with its price and a Buy button
alt.zh: Home Shop 窗口：左边是家具分类，右边选中了一张粉色沙发，下面是价格和购买按钮

alt.en: Han Mart's grocery window in the same style, with instant ramen selected
alt.zh: 同样风格的 Han Mart 超市窗口，选中了一碗泡面

title.en: LA has a soundtrack now
title.zh: 洛杉矶有了自己的配乐

en: Every neighborhood has its own music: a breezy beach track in Santa Monica and Venice, a bit of sparkle for Hollywood, a Koreatown groove, a Downtown beat, and a quiet night theme once it's past 8 pm.
Your home, cafés, work shifts and parties get their own tracks too. The music waits for your first click or tap, so nothing blares when the game opens.

On top of that: more than 35 little sound effects, footsteps that change on wood, tile and pavement, and soft background sounds for the street, the beach, the parks, cafés and the night. Turn any of it up or down in Settings.
zh: 每个街区都有了自己的音乐：圣莫尼卡和威尼斯是轻快的海边曲子，好莱坞闪闪发光，韩国城有自己的律动，市中心节奏感十足，晚上 8 点以后换成安静的夜晚主题。
家里、咖啡店、上班和派对也各有一首。音乐会等你第一次点击后才开始，打开游戏时不会突然很吵。
另外还有 35 个以上的小音效，脚步声会随着木地板、瓷砖和马路变化，街道、海滩、公园、咖啡店和夜晚都有轻柔的环境声。在设置里可以分别调大调小。

title.en: Tap a player: the social wheel
title.zh: 点一下玩家：社交轮盘

en: Click or tap another player and a little wheel of round buttons opens beside them. From there you can add them as a friend, send a message, invite them to hang out, take a photo together, or go for a wave, a fist bump or a high five.
Messages unlock once you're friends. A hang-out invite lets you pick the plan, like a coffee at the café around the corner.
On phones, the first tap lights a button up and the second one picks it, so nobody gets an accidental high five.
zh: 点一下其他玩家，旁边就会弹出一圈圆圆的按钮：加好友、发消息、约出去玩、一起拍照，或者挥挥手、碰个拳、击个掌。
成为好友之后才能发消息。约人出去玩的时候可以选好计划，比如去街角的咖啡店喝一杯。
在手机上，第一下点亮按钮，第二下才确认，不会一不小心就击掌了。

alt.en: Leo opens the social wheel next to Ivy in the tower corridor, with Fist bump highlighted
alt.zh: Leo 在公寓走廊里对 Ivy 打开社交轮盘，“碰拳”被高亮

alt.en: The wheel on a Koreatown street at night, with Hang out highlighted
alt.zh: 夜晚韩国城街头的社交轮盘，“一起玩”被高亮

title.en: Ten new neighbors
title.zh: 十位新邻居

en: Ten new citizens moved in: Jiwoo, Marcus, Lupe, Hank, Kiran, Layla, Keoni, Imani, Sungmin and Roxy. You'll run into them around Koreatown, Downtown, Santa Monica, Venice and Hollywood.
Look out for Lupe's flowered sun hat, Hank's beach shirt, Keoni's basketball jersey and Roxy's teal curls.
zh: 十位新居民搬来了：Jiwoo、Marcus、Lupe、Hank、Kiran、Layla、Keoni、Imani、Sungmin 和 Roxy。在韩国城、市中心、圣莫尼卡、威尼斯和好莱坞都能遇到他们。
留意一下 Lupe 插着花的遮阳帽、Hank 的海滩衬衫、Keoni 的篮球背心，还有 Roxy 的一头青绿色卷发。

alt.en: All ten new citizens gathered at a Koreatown crosswalk
alt.zh: 十位新居民聚在韩国城的斑马线旁

title.en: Hot water, finally
title.zh: 终于有热水了

en: Showers actually run now. Step in and the water streams down, steam fogs up the glass, and it all fades away after you step out.
Taps and tubs pour too (a bath slowly fills while you wait), and the outdoor showers by the beach work after a swim.
zh: 淋浴终于会出水了。走进去，水哗哗地流下来，玻璃上起了一层雾，走出来之后再慢慢消失。
水龙头和浴缸也会放水（浴缸会一点点装满），海边的露天淋浴也能在游完泳后冲一冲。

alt.en: A player showering in the studio bathroom, water running behind the glass
alt.zh: 玩家在小公寓的浴室里淋浴，玻璃后面水在流

alt.en: Rinsing off at an outdoor shower by the beach rentals
alt.zh: 在海滩租赁小屋旁的露天淋浴冲水

title.en: Things to do together
title.zh: 和朋友一起做的事

en: The new Together menu is home base for everything you do with friends: take photos together and keep them in your album, fill memory books, check the city feed, and set a status so friends know what you're up to.
Catch a sunset at the shore with a friend and you'll get a postcard of it.
Hosts got proper house rules too: lock your door, let each visitor in when they knock, and choose what guests may use.
zh: 新的“一起”菜单，装下了和朋友一起做的所有事：一起拍照并收进相册、做回忆册、看城市动态，还能设置状态，让朋友知道你在忙什么。
和朋友一起在海边看日落，会收到一张那一刻的明信片。
房主也有了自己的规矩：可以锁门，每位访客敲门时由你决定让不让进，还能设置客人可以用哪些东西。

alt.en: The Together menu open in a studio: status, photo together, album, city feed, memory books and guest rules
alt.zh: 在小公寓里打开“一起”菜单：状态、一起拍照、相册、城市动态、回忆册和访客规则

title.en: Karaoke rooms, a hotel lobby and a gallery
title.zh: KTV 包厢、酒店大堂和美术馆

en: Three new places for a night out: book a private room at Nora Karaoke inside Star Karaoke, meet up in the Mirador lobby at the Hollywood boulevard hotel, or wander through Form Space at the art museum.
A booked karaoke room becomes a party for the host's friends.
zh: 三个晚上出去玩的新去处：在 Star Karaoke 里的 Nora KTV 订一间包厢，在好莱坞大道上的老牌酒店的 Mirador 大堂碰头，或者去 the art museum 的 Form Space 逛一逛。
订好的 KTV 包厢会变成房主好友们的派对。

title.en: New spots on the block
title.zh: 街上开了好多新店

en: Koreatown got Level Up Arcade and Side B Records, Venice got Curb Skate Supply, and Santa Monica got Sol Citrus, a juice bar in a sunny courtyard.

Also new: Side A Records in Hollywood, the Stem & Story florist in Koreatown and the Shift Cycle Works bike shop downtown, plus fresh layouts for a tea bar, a gelato shop, a rice-roll diner and the Venice taco stand.
zh: 韩国城开了 Level Up 电玩城和 Side B 唱片行，威尼斯开了 Curb 滑板店，圣莫尼卡多了一家开在阳光庭院里的果汁吧 Sol Citrus。
还有好莱坞的 Side A 唱片行、韩国城的 Stem & Story 花店、市中心的 Shift Cycle Works 自行车行；奶茶吧、意式冰淇淋店、饭卷小馆和威尼斯的塔可摊也都换了新布局。

title.en: A real building to come home to
title.zh: 回家，有了真正的公寓楼

en: Every new player now gets a studio in one of four starter towers: Wilshire in Koreatown, Marquee in Hollywood, Coastline in Santa Monica and Foundry in Downtown.

Each has a lobby with a concierge, lifts up all 55 floors of homes, corridors where friends can knock on your door, a shared laundry, and rooms for residents: a cowork space, a club, a parcel room and a reuse room.
Back in your studio, decorate mode lets you pick one of three floor plans and fill it from the Home Shop.
zh: 现在每位新玩家都会在四栋公寓楼之一拿到一间小公寓：韩国城的 Wilshire、好莱坞的 Marquee、圣莫尼卡的 Coastline 和市中心的 Foundry。
每栋楼都有带前台的大堂、能到 55 层住户楼层的电梯、朋友可以来敲门的走廊、共用洗衣房，还有住户专属的房间：共享办公室、俱乐部、快递室和二手交换室。
回到自己的小公寓，用布置模式从三种户型里选一种，再去 Home Shop 把家填满。

title.en: Faces with feelings
title.zh: 会表达心情的脸

en: Characters got new faces in the style of our poster: bigger eyes, little drawn mouths and brows, soft blush, and expressions that change when they laugh or chat.
Skin tones are brighter and less orange, and everyone has a softer, matte toy finish.
zh: 角色们换上了和海报一样风格的新脸：更大的眼睛、画出来的小嘴巴和眉毛、淡淡的腮红，聊天和大笑时表情也会跟着变。
肤色更明亮，不再偏橙，每个人都有一层柔和的哑光玩具质感。

title.en: A warmer, toy-town LA
title.zh: 更温暖的玩具小镇洛杉矶

en: The whole city went through a few art passes: warmer colors, rounder toy-like buildings, and streets that feel much closer to the real Melrose Avenue.
LA's trees arrived too: fan palms, date palms, flowering jacarandas and leafy street trees. Shops and homes now sit on a pale-blue backdrop instead of a dark stage.
zh: 整座城市经过了几轮美术打磨：颜色更暖，建筑更圆润、更像玩具，街道也更接近真实的 Melrose 大道。
洛杉矶的树也种上了：扇叶棕榈、海枣、开花的蓝花楹，还有枝叶茂盛的行道树。商店和家里的背景从暗色舞台换成了浅蓝色。

title.en: Hello, Los Angeles
title.zh: 你好，洛杉矶

en: LetsMeetVerse started as a small online life sim set in real Los Angeles: Santa Monica, Venice, Hollywood, Koreatown, Downtown and Mid-City, all on one map.
From the first day you could rent a bike, skate in Venice, take a surf lesson, sing karaoke, and play on your phone or your computer.
This is how the pier looked back then. It has come a long way.
zh: LetsMeetVerse 一开始是一个小小的线上生活模拟游戏，设定在真实的洛杉矶：圣莫尼卡、威尼斯、好莱坞、韩国城、市中心和中城，都在同一张地图上。
第一天就可以租单车、去威尼斯玩滑板、上冲浪课、唱 KTV，手机和电脑都能玩。
这是当时码头的样子。之后变化可大了。

title.en: Landmarks you'll recognize
title.zh: 一眼就能认出的地标

en: Hollywood got the grand movie palace, a classic stage theatre, an old picture house and a historic boulevard hotel, with a pool, a bar and rooms for the night.
Downtown got Silverwave Hall, Central Commons Market, the Ironcourt building and the Jade Clock tower, and Koreatown got its malls with food courts.
zh: 好莱坞有了电影宫、老牌舞台剧院、老电影院和大道上的老牌酒店，酒店里有泳池、酒吧，还能住一晚。
市中心有了银浪音乐厅、中央共享市集、铁庭大楼和 玉钟楼，韩国城也有了带美食广场的商场。

title.en: Own a piece of the city
title.zh: 买下城市的一角

en: Every shop, home and landmark goes up for auction. Win one and it's yours to keep: collect income from the business inside, run your own counter with your own products and prices, or sell it on.
Billboards are auctions too. Win a board and your picture goes up over the street. And money is now coins, with a rich list for the city's biggest savers.
zh: 每一家店、每一处住宅和地标都可以拍卖。拍下来就永远是你的：可以收店里的生意分成，开一个自己的柜台、自己定商品和价格，也可以转手卖掉。
广告牌也能竞拍，拍下后你的图片就会挂在街上。游戏里的钱换成了金币，还有一个城市富豪榜。

title.en: Getting around, and a dog of your own
title.zh: 出门的方式，还有属于你的狗狗

en: Buses run along the big boulevards, taxis and rideshares pick you up at the curb, bike-share docks are all over town, and you can carpool with friends in an open-top car where everyone can see you. Cars need fuel, so the gas stations matter now.
You can also adopt a dog at a pet shop. It trots after you wherever you go, and the new parks have dog runs, playgrounds and half-courts for pickup basketball.
zh: 大马路上有公交车，出租车和网约车在路边接你，共享单车到处都有，还能和朋友开敞篷车拼车，路上的人都看得到你们。车要加油，加油站也派上用场了。
还可以在宠物店领养一只狗狗，你走到哪它就跟到哪。新开的公园里有遛狗区、游乐场和可以打街头篮球的半场。

title.en: Friends, family and the Match app
title.zh: 朋友、家人和交友 App

en: Friendships grow in levels now, and you can build a family tree: partner, spouse, siblings, parents and children.
Visit a friend's studio when they're home, throw a party, join the daily city events, or open the Match app to find people who like the same things you do (dating is 18+ only).
zh: 友情现在会一级一级地升温，还可以组建家族树：伴侣、配偶、兄弟姐妹、父母和孩子。
朋友在家时可以去串门，可以开派对、参加每天的城市活动，也可以打开交友 App 找兴趣相投的人（恋爱功能仅限 18 岁以上）。
